Actual Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 entry in [[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]], PDF page 26, rectangle [179, 207, 494, 263] points, rendered at 3 pixels/point. Published documentary words include literal W before Landspeed and the explicit white-border misprint statement. No full-card reconstruction or invented mark. [[Category:Card images]]
